# Released Bergamot model pairs for benchmarking (qvac_bergamot backend)
# One pair per line in format: src-trg (e.g., en-it)
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored
#
# Models are downloaded via Hyperdrive if a key exists, otherwise
# downloaded directly from Firefox Translations GitHub (git-lfs fallback).
# Any pair supported by Firefox Translations can be added here.
# See: https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models
